notes.title: What is the current state of the Early Access version?
notes.notes:
[h3]What is the current state of the Early Access version?[/h3]

The current status of the early access version is as follows.

[olist]
[*] You can play against robots and against other players.
[*] A practice field has been implemented, allowing you to check the use of weapons and items.
[*] A tutorial has been implemented so that you can quickly get to know the controls.
[*] Configuration is implemented, allowing you to adjust mouse sensitivity and key bindings.
[/olist]


[h3]Roadmap[/h3]

Based on community feedback, criticisms, and suggestions for future features, the following features will be implemented in the Early Access version.

[olist]
[*] [strike]Implement an auto-aim function for the gamepad.[/strike] (Implemented in 0.9.13!)
[*] New weapons, equipment, animations, consumables, and implants will be implemented.
[*] New maps will be implemented.
[*] A store will be implemented so that players can purchase items whenever they wish.
[*] A team deathmatch mode will be implemented. (However, the game mode may change depending on the situation.)
[/olist]


Thank you for your cooperation.
